title: OpenRTB 2.6 UserAgent
description: Structured user agent information from User-Agent Client Hints.

browsers.description: Each BrandVersion object identifies a browser or similar software component.

platform.description: A BrandVersion object identifying the user agent's execution platform/OS.

mobile.description: 1 if the agent prefers mobile content, 0 for desktop/full.

source.description: Source of data used to create this object. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: User-Agent Source.
